cardText: Design, build and hand over under one contract — from empty shell to a completed, tested, ready-to-occupy space.
metaTitle: Turnkey Project Contracting in Dubai | Innova Group
metaDescription: Turnkey fit-out and construction contracting in Dubai — design coordination, authority approvals, civil and MEP works, finishes, testing and snag-free handover under one contract.
heading: One contract, from empty shell to open doors.
intro: You hand over a space and a brief. We hand back a finished, tested, authority-approved environment — with a single team answerable for every trade in between.

overview.heading: The whole build, under one signature
overview.lead: Splitting a fit-out across a designer, a main contractor, an MEP subcontractor and an AV specialist means four programmes, four invoices and four versions of whose fault it is.
body: Turnkey contracting removes that. We take responsibility for design coordination, procurement, construction, services, finishes and commissioning — and for the sequence that holds them together. One programme, one cost plan, one project lead who answers the phone.

We work across residential villas and apartments, offices and clinics, retail and F&B units, and hospitality spaces. Scope can be fixed-price against a detailed bill of quantities, or open-book where the design is still moving.

scope.heading: What sits inside a turnkey contract
scope.lead: A typical engagement covers all of the following. Anything you want to keep in-house, we exclude in writing before we start.
items: Site survey, measured drawings and existing-condition report
Design coordination, technical drawings and value engineering
Civil works, partitions, ceilings and structural alterations
MEP — electrical, HVAC, plumbing, drainage and fire systems
Joinery, wardrobes, kitchens and specialist finishes
Flooring, tiling, paint and decorative surfaces
AV, low-current, networking and smart-home integration
Independent snagging and rectification before handover
As-built drawings, O&M manuals, warranties and asset list

packages.heading: Three ways to engage us
packages.sub: Every package is quoted against your actual drawings and site conditions. Scope is fixed in writing before mobilisation.

tiers.name: Fit-Out Essential
tiers.for: Single apartments, small offices and defined scopes with a tight programme.
items: Fixed-price scope with itemised bill of quantities
Named project lead and weekly progress report
Handover pack with warranties and asset list

tiers.name: Turnkey Complete
tiers.for: Full-space delivery where you want one party from concept through to keys.
items: Full authority submissions, permits and NOCs
Joinery, specialist finishes and FF&E procurement

tiers.name: Design & Build Plus
tiers.for: Multi-unit, phased or landmark projects needing programme control and ongoing support.
items: Phased delivery programme with milestone reporting
Dedicated cost plan and formal change-control process
Value engineering workshops at each design stage
Monthly client report pack and cash-flow forecast

steps.title: Survey
steps.text: We measure the space, record existing conditions and confirm what the building and authority will allow.

steps.title: Price
steps.text: A detailed bill of quantities, a programme with milestone dates, and a written list of exclusions.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: One site team, sequenced trades, weekly progress reporting and photographic records throughout.

steps.title: Hand over
steps.text: Testing, commissioning, independent snagging, rectification, then documentation and keys.

faqs.q: Can you work in an occupied building?
faqs.a: Yes. We regularly phase works or run out-of-hours programmes in occupied offices, retail units and residential buildings, coordinating with building management on access, noise windows and service isolations.

faqs.q: Who handles the authority approvals?
faqs.a: We do. Submissions, permits and NOCs are part of the Turnkey Complete and Design & Build Plus packages, and available as an add-on to Fit-Out Essential.

faqs.q: Can you take over a project another contractor started?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes — subject to a condition survey and a written record of what was completed and to what standard before we mobilise.

faqs.q: Is the price fixed?
faqs.a: Fixed-price against an agreed bill of quantities is our default. Where the design is still developing we can work open-book with an agreed management fee, converting to fixed price once drawings are frozen.

cardText: Independent control of programme, cost, quality and risk on your behalf — from brief and tender through to handover.
metaTitle: Project & Cost Management in Dubai | Innova Group
metaDescription: Independent project management in Dubai — tender management, contract administration, programme and cost control, site supervision, quality inspection and handover close-out.
heading: Your interests, represented on site.
intro: We don't build it. We make sure it gets built — to your programme, to your budget and to the standard you were promised.

overview.heading: A professional client-side team, without the headcount
overview.lead: A contractor's job is to deliver their scope profitably. Somebody has to hold the whole programme, verify what's been paid for and say no when it matters. That is our role.
body: Innova acts as your representative from the moment there is a brief. We shape the scope, run the tender, administer the contract, monitor the programme and cost, inspect the quality and close the project out with a documented handover.
The engagement is deliberately independent: where we are project managing, we are not also the contractor. You get advice that isn't defending its own margin.

scope.heading: What we manage on your behalf
scope.lead: Selected according to the package and the stage you bring us in at.
items: Brief development, feasibility and budget setting
Tender documentation, bid analysis and contractor selection
Cost planning, cash-flow forecasting and change control
Site supervision, inspections and quality verification
Risk register, issue log and mitigation tracking
Snagging oversight and defect rectification tracking
Handover, documentation audit and project close-out

packages.heading: Three levels of representation
packages.sub: Scaled to the size of the project and how much of it you want to keep in-house.

tiers.name: Advisory
tiers.for: You already have a contractor and want a professional eye on the work.
items: Monthly site inspection with photographic report
Payment application review before you certify
Risk and issue flagging in writing
Direct access to a named project director

tiers.name: Managed Delivery
tiers.for: Full client-side management from tender through to handover.
items: Weekly site supervision with minuted meetings
Cost plan, cash-flow forecast and change control

tiers.name: Programme Office
tiers.for: Multiple concurrent projects or a rolling capital programme.
items: Portfolio dashboard across all live projects

steps.title: Define
steps.text: We turn an intention into a brief: scope, budget, programme and the standard of finish expected.

steps.title: Procure
steps.text: Tender documents, a controlled bid process, comparable pricing and a recommendation you can defend.

steps.title: Control
steps.text: Programme, cost and quality tracked weekly, with variations assessed before they are approved.

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Snag close-out, documentation audit, final account and a written project review.

faqs.q: At what stage should we bring you in?
faqs.a: As early as possible — ideally before the design is tendered, when decisions about scope and budget are still inexpensive to change. We can also take over mid-project.

faqs.q: Do you also build the projects you manage?
faqs.a: Not on the same project. Where Innova is the client's project manager, the construction is delivered by a separate contractor so our advice stays independent.

faqs.q: How do you report?
faqs.a: A monthly pack covering programme status, cost against budget, variations, risks, quality observations and photographs — plus immediate written notice of anything that threatens a date or a number.

cardText: Planned and reactive maintenance that keeps buildings, systems and occupants running without interruption.
metaTitle: Facility Management & Maintenance in Dubai | Innova Group
metaDescription: Planned preventive and reactive maintenance in Dubai — AC servicing, electrical, plumbing, life-safety compliance, asset registers and 24/7 emergency response for villas and commercial property.
heading: Buildings that keep working after everyone goes home.
intro: Planned maintenance that prevents the call-out, and a response team for the times it still happens.

overview.heading: Maintenance as a schedule, not a reaction
overview.lead: Most property problems in this climate are predictable: AC performance, water systems, seals, electrical loads. They become expensive only when nobody is watching the schedule.
body: We build a maintenance regime around your actual assets — surveyed, listed and given a service interval — then run it to a calendar you can see. Reactive call-outs still happen, and we staff for them, but the aim is to make them rare.
We cover private villas and apartments, offices, clinics, retail units and mixed-use buildings, either as an annual contract or as part of a handover from one of our own construction projects.

scope.heading: What we look after
scope.lead: Coverage depends on the package and the asset survey carried out at the start of the contract.
items: Planned preventive maintenance schedules per asset
HVAC servicing, coil cleaning and filter replacement
Duct inspection and indoor air-quality checks
Electrical systems, distribution boards and lighting
Plumbing, drainage, pumps and water tank cleaning
Fire alarm, extinguisher and life-safety compliance
Civil repairs, sealing, waterproofing and paintwork
Pool plant and landscape maintenance where applicable
Asset register, condition survey and lifecycle planning
Monthly service records and KPI reporting

packages.heading: Annual maintenance contracts
packages.sub: Priced after an asset survey, so the schedule matches what you actually have on site.

tiers.name: Care
tiers.for: Villas, apartments and single units that need a reliable service rhythm.
items: AC servicing, filter cleaning and performance check
Priority call-out at agreed contract rates
Digital service record after every visit

tiers.name: Care Plus

Annual water tank cleaning and disinfection
Full asset register and condition report
Named account manager and quarterly review

steps.title: Survey
steps.text: We walk the property, list every serviceable asset and record its age, condition and service history.

steps.title: Schedule
steps.text: Each asset gets an interval and a task list. You receive the annual calendar before the contract starts.

steps.title: Service
steps.text: Planned visits are documented with photographs and readings. Reactive calls are logged and tracked to closure.

steps.title: Report
steps.text: Monthly service records, an annual condition report and a forecast of what will need replacing next.

faqs.q: Do you cover properties you didn't build?
faqs.a: Yes. Most of our maintenance contracts are on properties built by others. We start with an asset survey to establish the baseline condition before taking responsibility.

faqs.q: What counts as an emergency?
faqs.a: Anything affecting safety, security or habitability — water ingress, power loss, total AC failure, drainage backup, fire system faults. These are covered by the 24/7 line on Care Plus and Integrated FM.

faqs.q: Are parts included?
faqs.a: Labour on minor repairs is included from Care Plus upward. Consumables and replacement parts are charged at cost with prior approval above an agreed threshold.

cardText: Private cinemas and media rooms — engineered for acoustics, calibrated for picture, maintained for the long term.
metaTitle: Home Cinema Design, Installation & Maintenance in Dubai | Innova Group
metaDescription: Private cinema and home theatre design, installation, calibration and maintenance in Dubai — acoustic treatment, immersive audio, projection, automation and control systems.
heading: A room that disappears, so the film doesn't.
intro: Private cinemas, media rooms and multi-room audio — designed around acoustics and sightlines first, calibrated on completion, and serviced afterwards.

overview.heading: The room matters more than the equipment
overview.lead: Expensive speakers in an untreated room sound worse than modest speakers in a treated one. Most disappointing cinemas are a room problem wearing an equipment problem's clothes.
body: We start with the space: dimensions, reflections, seating distance, sightlines and where the noise is coming from. Only then do we specify equipment, and we specify it to suit the room rather than a price list.
Every installation is calibrated on completion — picture and sound measured and adjusted, not left at factory defaults — and handed over with a control system simple enough that guests can use it.

scope.heading: From acoustic model to first screening
scope.lead: Delivered as a standalone project or integrated into a wider fit-out by our contracting team.

Seating layout, risers and sightline planning
Projector, screen or display specification and throw calculation
Immersive surround audio design, including Dolby Atmos layouts
Cable infrastructure, equipment racks and power conditioning
Lighting design, blackout and scene automation
Control system programming for single-remote operation
Acoustic panelling, fabric walls and decorative finishes
Handover training for the household or staff
Ongoing service, firmware updates and recalibration

tiers.name: Dedicated Cinema

steps.title: Assess

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Acoustic treatment, seating, sightlines and an equipment schedule presented before anything is ordered.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: First-fix cabling coordinated with the build, then equipment, treatment, finishes and automation.

steps.title: Calibrate
steps.text: Measured calibration of picture and sound, control system programming, and training on handover.

faqs.q: Can you work alongside our interior designer?
faqs.a: Yes, and it usually produces a better room. We provide acoustic and technical requirements early so the designer can absorb them into the finishes rather than work around them afterwards.

faqs.q: Do we buy the equipment, or do you?
faqs.a: Either. We can supply and install as part of the package, or specify the schedule and install equipment you procure yourself.

faqs.q: Will you service a system you didn't install?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. We start with a system audit and a calibration check, then propose a service agreement based on what we find.

cardText: Independent pre-handover inspection with a photographic, room-by-room defect report your developer can act on.
metaTitle: Property Snagging Inspection in Dubai | Innova Group
metaDescription: Independent snagging inspections in Dubai — room-by-room defect reports with photographs, thermal imaging, moisture readings and re-inspection after developer rectification.
heading: Find it before you sign for it.
intro: An independent inspection of your property before handover. Every defect photographed, located and described in a report the developer can act on — and we come back to check they did.

overview.heading: The last moment your leverage is free
overview.lead: Once you accept handover, defects become a warranty claim: slower, more contested and sometimes at your cost. Before you accept, they are simply the developer's outstanding work.
body: A snagging inspection uses that window properly. We go through the property room by room against finishing standards, record every defect with a photograph and a location, grade it by severity, and issue a register formatted for the developer's own rectification process.
We are independent of the developer and the contractor. We are paid to find things.

scope.heading: Room by room, system by system
scope.lead: The inspection depth depends on the package; the reporting standard does not change.
items: Doors, windows, ironmongery, alignment and seals
Joinery, wardrobes, kitchen units and worktops
Tiling, grouting, flooring, skirting and transitions
Paint, plaster, ceilings and decorative finishes
Electrical points, switches, lighting and distribution boards
Plumbing fixtures, water pressure, drainage and leaks
Air conditioning performance, airflow and condensate
Thermal imaging of AC, wet areas and insulation gaps
Moisture readings on walls, floors and wet areas
Balconies, external finishes, roofs and drainage falls
Pool plant, landscape and external services where present
Severity-graded register with photographs and locations

packages.heading: Three depths of inspection
packages.sub: Priced by property type and size. Reports are issued in a developer-ready format.

tiers.name: Standard Snag
tiers.for: Apartments and townhouses at first handover.

tiers.name: Snag & Re-Inspect
tiers.for: Buyers who want the defects closed out, not just listed.
items: Thermal imaging of AC and wet areas
Updated close-out report confirming what was fixed
Written support if items remain outstanding

tiers.name: Villa & Portfolio
tiers.for: Large villas, multiple units or investor portfolios.
items: External areas, roof, balconies and drainage falls
Pool plant, landscape and external services
MEP performance testing across all systems
Attendance at the developer handover walkthrough

steps.title: Book
steps.text: Ideally before you sign the handover acceptance. We can usually attend within a few days.

steps.title: Inspect
steps.text: A methodical pass through every room and system, photographing and locating each defect.

steps.title: Report
steps.text: A severity-graded register issued within 48 hours, formatted so the developer can work from it directly.

steps.title: Re-inspect
steps.text: After rectification we return, verify each item and issue a close-out report confirming what was actually fixed.

faqs.q: When should the inspection happen?
faqs.a: Between the developer notifying you that the unit is ready and you signing the handover acceptance. That is the point at which outstanding work is still clearly the developer's obligation.

faqs.q: What if the developer disputes the report?
faqs.a: Every item is photographed, located and graded, which makes most items difficult to dispute. Where a disagreement remains, we can attend the walkthrough and present the finding directly.

faqs.q: Can you snag a property that's already handed over?
faqs.a: Yes. It is still useful within the defects liability period, and essential before a fit-out so that pre-existing defects are recorded before your own contractor starts.

faqs.q: Do you carry out the repairs?
faqs.a: Not on a property we have snagged for you — the inspection stays independent. If you want the work done, our contracting and maintenance teams can quote separately once the register is closed.

cardText: Operating models, processes and governance rebuilt so that growth doesn't outpace control.
metaTitle: Management Consultancy in Dubai | Innova Group
metaDescription: Operating model design, process documentation, governance frameworks, financial controls and performance management for growing companies in the UAE.
heading: Growth outruns process. We help it catch up.
intro: Operating models, documented processes, governance and controls — built for the size you are becoming rather than the size you were.

overview.heading: The company outgrew how it was run
overview.lead: Most operational pain in a growing business is not a people problem. It is a structure problem: decisions with no owner, processes that live in someone's head, and reporting that arrives too late to act on.
body: We diagnose that structure honestly — through interviews, process mapping and a look at the actual numbers — and then rebuild the parts that are failing. Target operating model, documented procedures, delegation of authority, financial controls, performance measures.
Recommendations are only half the job. We stay through implementation, because an unimplemented report changes nothing.

scope.lead: Selected according to the diagnostic findings and your priorities.
items: Role definition, accountability and span of control
Process mapping, SOPs and written procedures
Governance frameworks and delegation of authority
Financial controls, budgeting and reporting cadence
Commercial policy, pricing and procurement discipline
Systems selection and digital workflow design

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.text: Interviews, process mapping and data review to find where the structure is actually failing.

steps.title: Prioritise
steps.text: A roadmap scored by effort and impact, agreed with leadership before anything is built.

steps.title: Build

faqs.q: How disruptive is the diagnostic?
faqs.a: Light. It is typically two to four weeks of interviews and document review, taking an hour or so from each participant, with normal operations continuing throughout.

faqs.q: Will you write the SOPs, or do we?
faqs.a: We write them with your team, in your language, and hand over editable source documents. Procedures written entirely by outsiders tend not to survive contact with the people doing the work.

faqs.q: Do you implement software?
faqs.a: We help you select it and design the workflow around it, and can coordinate the vendor's implementation. For AI-specific systems, our AI practice builds and deploys directly.

cardText: Applied artificial intelligence — where it creates real value in your business, and how to deploy it safely.
metaTitle: AI Consultancy & Applied AI in Dubai | Innova Group
metaDescription: AI readiness assessment, use-case prioritisation, prototype development, workflow automation and responsible deployment for businesses in Dubai and the UAE.
heading: Artificial intelligence, applied where it actually pays.
intro: We start with your processes, not with a model. Where AI creates measurable value we build it. Where it doesn't, we say so.

overview.heading: Most AI projects fail on the use case, not the technology
overview.lead: The models are capable and getting more so. The failures we see are almost always upstream: a use case nobody needed, data that was never ready, or a pilot with no definition of success.
body: Our work begins with an assessment of where your organisation actually spends effort — the repetitive reading, writing, searching, checking and routing that consumes hours without producing judgement. Those are the places AI pays.

We then prioritise by value and feasibility, build one use case properly end-to-end, measure it against agreed success criteria, and only scale what earns it. Deployment includes the parts people skip: data governance, privacy, residency, evaluation and the training that gets it adopted.

scope.heading: What we do
scope.lead: Delivered as an assessment, a build, or an ongoing partnership.
items: Data readiness, quality and governance review
Use-case prioritisation by value and feasibility
Internal knowledge assistants and search over your own data

packages.heading: Assess, pilot, partner
packages.sub: Deliberately sequential. We would rather prove one use case than promise ten.

tiers.name: AI Readiness
tiers.for: Establishing where AI is worth applying before committing budget.
items: Process and data audit across key functions
Use-case long list scored by value and feasibility
Prioritised roadmap with indicative effort and cost

tiers.name: Pilot Build
tiers.for: Building the highest-value use case properly, end to end.
items: One production-ready use case built end to end
Success metrics agreed before development starts

tiers.name: AI Partner
tiers.for: Organisations building an ongoing AI capability rather than a single tool.
items: Internal knowledge assistant across your own data

steps.title: Assess
steps.text: Where does effort go, what data exists, and which tasks are repetitive enough to be worth automating.

steps.title: Prioritise
steps.text: Use cases scored by value and feasibility, with success criteria defined before anyone builds.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: One use case taken end to end — integrated, evaluated, tested with real users and deployed.

steps.title: Scale
steps.text: Monitoring, governance and the next use cases, added only once the previous one has proven itself.

faqs.q: Does our data leave our systems?
faqs.a: Only if you decide it should. Data residency and privacy requirements are established at the assessment stage, and the architecture is designed around them — including fully self-hosted deployments where that is required.

faqs.q: We have no AI experience internally. Is that a problem?
faqs.a: No. Most of our clients start from zero. Training and adoption support are part of the Pilot Build package precisely because a tool nobody uses is a wasted investment.

faqs.q: What if the assessment concludes AI isn't worth it?
faqs.a: Then we tell you that, and the assessment has saved you a great deal more than it cost. In many cases the honest answer is that a process fix or a conventional automation delivers the same result more cheaply.

faqs.q: How do you measure whether a pilot worked?
faqs.a: Against criteria agreed in writing before development begins — typically time saved, error rate, throughput or cost per transaction, measured against a documented baseline.
